# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** married  <sub>[v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Prissy  <sub>[v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014)</sub>; Pris  <sub>[v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P26](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0026), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as pale, fair, and spiritual-looking, with lovely hair and brown eyes. She is tall, standing a full two inches taller than most in a crowd. Following her marriage, her beauty is described as ethereal and golden.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Despite her pale, spiritual appearance, Priscilla is full of mischief, pranks, and fun. She has a strong poetic and romantic imagination, viewing the world with deep appreciation. She is practical, sensible, and determined when needed, though she can be critical of childish behavior or superficiality.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v2 c13 P69](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0069), [v3 c4 P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070), [v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), [v3 c9 P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley, forming a close friendship with her and Stella Maynard. After graduating, she taught school at Carmody before returning to teach at her home school. She later attended Redmond College in Kingsport, boarding with Anne Shirley and subsequently moving into Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue with Anne, Philippa Gordon, Stella Maynard, and Aunt Jamesina. Upon completing her studies at Redmond, Priscilla married a handsome foreign missionary and moved to Japan with him.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), [v3 c10 P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_
